doctrine_note: BLIND FIRST PASS: no prior blind exists to post-update, so I AM the forecast (100% my causal read; weight_assigned records no prior to weight against). Price curve is masked; my only market-force inputs are the never-masked tape_conditions (open-conditions protocol S102 - each owned day reads the PRIOR completed session's order-flow) plus the frozen non-price kitchen sink. I do NOT peek at a day's own realized-session tape to forecast that day. Magnitudes are derived from measurable flow/structure state, not fitted. HONEST bar: bearish down-default is held at REDUCED conviction, never claimed as sign-certain - the S105 accumulation/turn arm is checked and gated out, not ignored.

cross_cutting_mbo_finding.headline: The S105 big-print BUY-absorption accumulation arm is GATED OUT across every one of my open-condition tapes: big_print_b_share never reaches the 0.55 threshold anywhere in g19 (block max 0.537 on the 05-19 session; my owned-day opens read 0.458 / 0.446 / 0.395), so despite an extreme-AND-worsening COT short (MM net -107.5k -> -120.1k, 1y pctile 2.83 -> 0.94, the most crowded short in a year) there is NO confirmed turn to flip sign on.
cross_cutting_mbo_finding.what_it_means: The crowded short is a standing UPSIDE-ASYMMETRY / covering-squeeze risk (bimodal tail), not a live turn signal. Per doctrine 'honest under-claim is a magnitude lever, not a sign justification', and 'the S3-down default is not sign-certain just because the HDD override is gated out' - so I hold the bearish read (steep contango, front NGM26 -0.25 to next, L48 storage vs-5yr +99.6 surplus, mild shoulder weather) at reduced conviction with the covering tail flagged, rather than either riding it hard OR flipping to turn.
cross_cutting_mbo_finding.usable_mbo_grain: Only the COARSE grain carries signal: (1) phase-3 late flow FLIPS - 05-12 session ended -2559 phase2 then +409 phase3 with b_share climbing 0.431->0.445->0.475 = downside exhaustion / short-cover into the close, which CAPS Wed 05-13's downside; (2) resting-book bid-lean - qbid climbed to 0.528 on the low-volume 05-18 session (sellers hitting b_share 0.386 into stacked bids without breaking price) = absorption capping the 05-19 drift. Both are turn/absorption CONFIRMATION, not direction anticipation - consistent with the standing dipole discipline.
cross_cutting_mbo_finding.net_verdict: Bearish regime persists but is MATURE and short-crowded; the tape shows selling that increasingly gets ABSORBED (late-session buy flips, bid-lean book) rather than capitulating - so I size DOWN days honestly small and lean chop/give-back on the midweek days rather than extending fresh cum-lows.
